channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: How Trump’s Policy Agenda Runs Through One Federal Court, in Texas
item.description: For years, conservative litigants flocked to Judge Reed O’Connor’s district. Now, North Texas has become a favorite destination of the Justice Department.

item.title: NPR: Exclusive: Meet the inaugural winner of Fat Marmot Week
item.description: Dawn was crowned fattest marmot by popular vote.

item.title: BBC News: PC Harper's killers to stay in jail as PM announces changes to early release scheme
item.description: Andy Burnham tells BBC Breakfast anyone convicted of manslaughter will be excluded from the early release scheme in the Sentencing Act.

item.title: The Guardian: ‘You’re at war when you get attacked’: Mark Carney shows combative nature in face-off with Trump
item.description: The Canadian PM is one of the few world leaders to stand up to the US president. Former colleagues say they are not surprised Mark Carney stood before a walnut-veneered lectern, his face drawn tight, as he announced that…

item.title: Al Jazeera: How does your name taste? The strange science of synaesthesia
item.description: Experiencing names as tastes - a form of synaesthesia - reveals how differently people perceive the same world.

item.title: Ars Technica: Inside Meta’s push to put robots to work in data centers
item.description: The company is testing robots on tasks that can performed by technicians.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: How Teen ‘After-Prom’ Kings in LA Monetized the High School Rager
item.description: The West Coast house-party scene has long been iconic. For these young, tech-savvy entrepreneurs, it was also inspiration for MyPlots, a party-promotion empire.

item.title: WIRED Science: Scientists Create the Littlest Big Bang to Study the Universe's Origins
item.description: The discovery redefines how large atoms need to be to produce the extreme state of matter found in the early universe.

item.title: WIRED Business: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Took a Call From Donald Trump in the Middle of an All-Hands
item.description: The unexpected interruption came hours before the president wrote a congratulatory post on Truth Social about the company’s most recent earnings report.

item.title: The New Yorker: Susan Te Kahurangi King’s Way of Seeing
item.description: At seventy-five, she may be New Zealand’s greatest living artist.

item.title: New York Mag The Cut: Your Weekly Horoscopes by Madame Clairevoyant: August 30–September 5
item.description: This week’s waning moon offers an apt opportunity for reflection.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: Fire Island’s Pyramid House Is for Sale
item.description: The distinctive modernist house, designed for a J.P. Morgan descendant, has been updated and listed with a price cut.

item.title: Fox59: Indianapolis Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen arrested on OWI charges
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS — Indianapolis Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen has been arrested on OWI charges. According to a public police report, the 34-year-old Colts wideout was arrested in downtown Indianapolis around 1 a.m. Sunday…
